feed_title: Large Plush Bolster Dog Bed 110 x 75cm, Deep Filled Sides All Round, Non-Slip Base, Machine Washable Cover | PawLunova Troutbeck
descriptionHtml:
110 × 75cm. Bolsters round every edge. Large without the large price.

Troutbeck is a large plush bolster dog bed, 110 × 75cm, with deep filled bolsters around the whole edge, a plush middle and a non-slip base.

Large dog beds get expensive quickly, and the cheap ones are large the way a spaniel is large. Yours ends up with a shoulder on the floorboards and back legs off the end.

At 110 × 75cm there is room for a big dog to stretch right out, with a deep filled bolster running the whole way round, so there is an edge wherever they finish up facing.

What they get

  • Deep filled bolsters right round the edge: Something to settle against on every side.
  • A plush middle: Soft-filled rather than foam, so it is cosy rather than firm.
  • 110 × 75cm of bed: Genuinely large, not large for a spaniel.
  • A non-slip base: It stays where you put it on wood, laminate and tiles.
  • A cover that comes off: Straight into the machine, following the sewn-in instructions.

Best for: Big dogs who sleep jammed against something soft, on a budget that stops short of £150.

Why it is worth the money

£49 gets you 110 × 75cm, a bolster around the entire edge, a non-slip base and a cover you can actually take off. It is one of the most affordable large beds we sell. The saving comes from the fill rather than the size.

So here is the catch, stated properly. It is soft, not supportive. The base is filled rather than foam, so a heavy dog sinks in instead of being held level. If that matters, our memory foam beds are the other answer.

Size and fit

SizeDimensions (cm)
Large110 × 75

That is the outside measurement and the bolsters take part of it. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Take the cover off and wash it as the sewn-in label directs. Let it dry fully in the air before it goes back on.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

One size, 110 × 75cm outside. Measure them stretched out; the bolsters take a share.

How much is delivery, and how quickly does it arrive?

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. An estimate comes with your basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment options sit alongside card payment at checkout.

Is it firm enough for a big heavy dog?

No, and we would rather say so. The middle is plush and soft-filled. Firm support means foam.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

We can tell you what it is made of: a soft plush surface, bolsters on every edge, a base that will not slide.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The cover machine washes at the temperature its label gives. Air-dry before refitting.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Then it goes back. Within 100 nights, free collection and full refund.

Order the 110 × 75cm and give them an edge on every side.
